title: Gemini adds Mac desktop control for US paid subscribers
summary: Google has made a Gemini feature available to Mac users in the US who use the Gemini Mac app and subscribe to Google AI Plus, Pro, or Ultra. It can click, type, navigate menus, and fill forms on the user&\#x27;s behalf in a separate background window while the user continues using the main screen and cursor. Users can restrict which apps Gemini can access, watch its actions in real time, pause it at any time, and approve key actions before they are carried out.

references.title: Google’s Gemini Can Now Control Mac Devices on Users’ Behalf
